title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.36478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The tragedy of the commons poses a multi-agent safety problem: reward-seeking agents can deplete a shared resource, and cooperation among its users does not itself specify how much must be preserved. We make preservation an explicit requirement by formulating a regenerative commons as a constrained Markov game or a constrained multi-agent MDP with a designer-specified depletion budget. We develop a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs a policy sequence from solutions of unconstrained games or cooperative control problems. Extending earlier time-average constructions, we introduce average-epoch solution concepts for reset episodes with discounted rewards and terminal costs. We prove a reward-independent feasibility certificate, cooperative feasibility and approximate optimality against feasible policy mixtures, and an extension to unbiased sampled costs. translated_title: 在可再生公地中学习不崩溃地收获：一个拉格朗日框架
translated_abstract: 公地悲剧构成了一个多智能体安全问题：追逐奖励的智能体可能会耗尽共享资源，而使用者之间的合作本身并不规定必须保留多少资源。我们通过将可再生公地形式化为约束马尔可夫博弈或带有设计者指定耗竭预算的约束多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），使“资源保护”成为一项显式要求。我们开发了一种非平稳拉格朗日框架，从无约束博弈或合作控制问题的解出发构建策略序列。通过扩展早期的时间平均构造，我们为带有折扣奖励和终端成本的重置片段引入了平均片段（average-epoch）解概念。我们证明了一个与奖励无关的可行性证书、合作可行性以及相对于可行策略混合的近似最优性，并将结果扩展到无偏采样成本的情形。对于自利智能体，一个受约束的纳什证书量化了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将可再生公地中的资源保护形式化为带设计者指定耗竭预算的约束多智能体博弈，并提出一种非平稳拉格朗日框架，从无约束博弈或合作控制问题的解构建策略序列，同时证明了与奖励无关的可行性证书和近似最优性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes preservation in a regenerative commons as a constrained multi-agent game with a designer-specified depletion budget and develops a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs policy sequences from unconstrained game or cooperative control solutions, proving reward-independent feasibility certificates and approximate optimality guarantees.
